La Maison is made purely out of the pleasure of map making, with the priority and ambition for making aesthetic details. The layout of the map has a dense and compact house in the middle, with tight and narrow corridors and areas - a house which is surrounded by large open outdoor areas. The weapon and armors are concentrated in the middle area, while powerups are spread out on the large open areas.
